posed_by: Paul Erdős, Arthur Rubin, and Herbert Taylor
note: The list coloring conjecture was posed in the foundational 1979 paper 'Choosability in graphs.' While Vizing introduced the concept of list coloring in 1976, Erdős, Rubin, and Taylor's 1979 work formalized the field and posed the major conjectures driving research in list coloring.
